statement_of_scope: Two histories are kept separate. Track A is the parameter ancestry of the selected alpha075 weights. Track B lists later research branches that were initialized FROM alpha075 (or from other checkpoints) but whose updates are NOT present in alpha075. No branch below is summed into a cumulative exposure figure for alpha075.

non_inferences: Track B updates must not be summed into a cumulative training-exposure figure for alpha075.
Response-distillation data were consumed by later branches; that does not place them in the alpha075 weight path.
lambda_B in the five-point A/B grid is unrelated to the alpha coefficient that produced alpha075; alpha075 is a read-only off-grid comparator there, never a parent.

The shared-tokenizer soft-KD lab used external SmolLM2 models to isolate method learning and token alignment on a matched-tokenizer pair. Describing it as chosen 'precisely so it could not contaminate PetitGPT' overstated the recorded rationale.
